what you did while you were waiting

questions.text: Describe a time when you had to wait for something.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you had to wait for something. You should say: what you were waiting for; how long you had to wait; what you did while you were waiting; and explain how you felt about waiting.

questions.text: Do you usually wait for things patiently?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you usually wait for things patiently?

questions.text: In what situations do people in your country usually have to wait?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you had to wait for something, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all waiting in daily life. In what situations do people in your country usually have to wait?

questions.text: How can shops and banks reduce the time customers spend waiting?
questions.say: How can shops and banks reduce the time customers spend waiting?

questions.text: Why do some people get angry when they have to wait?
questions.say: Why do some people get angry when they have to wait?

questions.text: Has the internet made people more impatient? Why?
questions.say: Now let's talk about patience and modern life. Has the internet made people more impatient? Why?

questions.text: Is patience an important quality for a leader?
questions.say: Is patience an important quality for a leader?

questions.text: Can patience be taught, or is it part of a person's character?
questions.say: Can patience be taught, or is it part of a person's character?
